# What the reader found

The decline rate rose from 1.1 per cent to 4.2 per cent over eight days, and
the rise is not spread evenly.

## What is declining

- **One brand is 9 per cent of attempts and 38 per cent of declines.**
  Nothing about its traffic changed.
- The second attempt declines with the first, inside 900 milliseconds.

The service writes the result as `declined` and keeps nothing else.
